system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: `moai init` lays down 33 sections in all; the six below are the ones you end up editing.
system_prompt_style.note: Harness over Claude Code; context assembled from rules, skills, hooks (SessionStart fills environment). Mechanism code not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: `@NAV:DEC`, `@NAV:SYM`, and `@MX:SPEC` bind into one addressable graph (`nav-graph.json`).
env_context_strategy.note: Navigator/codemaps plus Explore agent navigation; injection default unclear.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Verbose output spills to disk files, leaving only the exit code and a bounded tail (max 50 lines) in context.
context_compaction.note: summarize via Claude Code auto-compact (handle-compact.sh hooks); /clear recommendations.

observation_format.note: Observation conversion is done by Claude Code; not in evidence.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: It exposes 21 MoAI tools in six groups to Claude Code.

tool_count.note: Claude Code built-in tool list not in evidence; MCP tools (21) excluded by rule.

edit_primitive.note: Edit tools belong to Claude Code, not shown.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: the self-hosted `moai mcp-server` (a local stdio server). It exposes 21 MoAI tools in six groups to Claude Code.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: `moai init` provisions exactly **one** active MCP entry by default

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: All work flows through plan → run → sync.
loop_primitives.note: Hooks give event-driven; auditor DEBT loops give generate_test_repair; goal engine loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Progress stays in `progress.md`, handoff messages in memory, routing decisions in decision memory.
planning_granularity.note: SPEC documents authored in plan phase and read in run/sync.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a factory card goes **whole to one lane**, and that lane carries it through `plan → run → sync` serially in-session, each phase spawned as `Agent()` subagents.
multi_agent_topology.note: Default /moai pipeline delegates to manager agents; kanban multi-session optional.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: A lane runs up to 10 concurrent `Agent()` subagents, and write-capable spawns are isolated in their own worktree.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Four hard boundaries are attached — a turn limit (default 30), a stagnation guard, a wall-clock budget, and pre-approval gates
human_in_loop.note: Permission hooks in .claude/hooks; rule changes approval-gated.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: WorktreeNode (13 fields) | Per-session state: ID, parent, depth, origin chain, milestone, resume target

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Routing decisions and gate evidence accumulate in decision memory as material for the next run.
long_term_memory.note: Skills in .claude/skills; memory files; decision memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: A 6-block paste-ready resume message carries progress into the next session; in auto-inject mode, one message resumes the session.

self_verification.evidence_quote: `/moai gate` runs lint + format + type + tests in one pass, and sync-auditor scores across four dimensions

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Declare a completion condition and the session works on its own until it holds.
retry_policy.note: Goal engine capped at 30 turns by default; auditor DEBT loops.

rollback.evidence_quote: Every SPEC gets its own working tree. Enter with `moai cc -w <name>`

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Four hard boundaries are attached — a turn limit (default 30), a stagnation guard, a wall-clock budget, and pre-approval gates
termination_condition.note: Token circuit breaker aborts at 90%; mechanical exit-code goal conditions.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: a token circuit breaker stands guard — it aborts at the hard limit (default 90%)
cost_controls.note: Model profiles route by phase/tier; prompt cache reuse.

timeouts.evidence_quote: a turn limit, a stagnation guard, a wall-clock budget, and pre-approval gates are attached
timeouts.note: Per-tool timeouts from Claude Code not shown.
